notes.content:
1. Support SVG images when setting shortcut icons

notes.title: V5.18.1 Optimization & Fix
notes.content:
1. Fixed multilingual issue caused by cache when recreating window after release.
2. Fixed issue where Workshop could not be opened a second time.

notes.title: V5.18.0 Add Mouse Follow Display
notes.content:
1. Added mouse follow display option in settings. When checked, after hiding and pressing hotkey to show, the window will automatically display at the current mouse position and adjust its position following the monitor edge.
2. Optimized quick switch window logic for maximum efficiency.

notes.title: V5.17.6 Optimizations & Fixes
notes.content:
1. Added quick entries for both new and old uninstall tools in System Tools
2. Fixed untranslated text in Settings

notes.title: V5.17.4 Optimizations & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
1. Improved path recognition in quick switch tool, added %localappdata% support;
2. Fixed poor tooltip display in multilingual mode.

notes.title: V5.17.2 Optimization and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
1. Removed all DLL dependencies except for Steam.
2. Fixed crash issue when base64 conversion results contain newline characters.

notes.title: V5.17.1 Toolbox Feature Added
notes.content:
1. Added toolbox entry, currently only base64 and md5 functions are included.
2. Removed entry click from the right-click menu in the toolbox window, only keeping the show/hide entry.
3. In the tray right-click menu, if quick switch content exists, added the exit program entry.

notes.title: V5.16.1 Fix Startup Issue and Tray Menu Shortcut Switch
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue where the app couldn't open in the last version;
2. When there are shortcut switch configurations, the tray right-click menu will show them first. This can be changed to the original system menu in settings.

notes.title: V5.16.0 Workshop Update - Support for Any File Upload
notes.content: Now you can upload any file through the Workshop entrance on the main interface, in addition to uploading your own images in puzzle games, making it easier for everyone to share their files.

notes.title: V5.15.0 Enhanced Search Customization
notes.content:
Now supports setting multiple custom search contents:
1. Cleaned up previously less frequently used ones;
2. Removed functionality of custom search previously set in settings;
3. Added a settings button on the right side of the search box, click to enter the new custom search management window;
4. Optimized the icon of the previously anonymous access to make the corresponding function more intuitive.

Additionally, because some deletions have been made, users who have previously set up settings may find it difficult to accept for a while. Here, I would like to say:
!!!Sorry!!!
This is also an improvement for subsequent new users to change the use of this function.
If you cannot find the previously set custom search content for a while,
You can access the path %appdata%\QuickMatrix\config.ini file and search for [_Search] inside to find the previously set content,
Hope the new improvements can help everyone improve efficiency further.

notes.title: V5.13.0 Browser Drag & Drop Support
notes.content:
New Feature:
Supports dragging links directly from the browser to this window, which will generate the corresponding entry.
If dragged to the web icon, it will display the icon; otherwise, a blank icon will be shown.

Issue Fixes:
1. Fixed the issue where the webpage starts twice when launched.
2. Fixed the Steam startup association issue. The daily user statistics were low, and then we found this issue. I hope everyone can understand as we want to see relatively real data.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42494895/b305a0c44519c3cc7da474ced28163bbf5ccfae0.gif[/img]

notes.title: V5.11.0 Add shortcut key functionality to switch the current window to the top.
notes.content:
Added a shortcut key, default is Ctrl+F2, can be modified in settings.
It changes the current window's hierarchy, toggling between <Top> and <Not Top>.
When the current window is not on top, the shortcut key will bring it to the top, and if the window has a taskbar, the title will be marked with <**>;
When the current window is already on top, it will be brought down, and if the window has a taskbar with the <**> mark, it will be removed.
See the effect in the following Gif:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42494895/c3caa5c6c7b0dcbcdca957058edcc5d759d93368.gif[/img]

notes.title: V5.7.3 Bug Fixes
notes.content:
1. Fixed an issue where some programs might encounter errors due to local path problems when opening other programs;
2. Fixed an issue in quick replacement where replacing files with \\ in local network paths was not supported.

notes.title: V5.7.0 Text Replacement Fixes and Unique Child Node Activation Development.
notes.content:
1.Fix issue with incorrect names when creating new child nodes for text replacement and non-functional right-click menu
2.Add unique child node activation, other results will automatically close when switching child nodes

notes.title: V5.6.1 Quickly replace file paths in files with macro support.
notes.content:
When using file replacement or content replacement in the Quick Switch tool, the corresponding file paths support the following macro paths:
1.%appdata%
2.%userprofile%
3.%systemroot%
4.%temp%
5.%programfiles%
6.%alluserprofile%

notes.title: Happy New Year and recent plans
notes.content:
Dear users,
Happy New Year.
I've been busy lately,

notes.title: V2.5.0 Feature Update
notes.content:
Right-click menu:
Add:
1. Replace file/folder
2. Copy and replace file/folder
Delete:
1. Switch to the target file;
2. Switch to the target folder;

The company's projects are updated with new branch every two weeks,
In this way, the daily build directory will change every time,
Previously, switching the shortcut destination folder required selecting a directory,
But the build directory is a network directory and cannot be selected,
cause I have to do it again,
So this time I re-wrote the function of switching targets function

A new window will appear when switching targets,
Just drag and drop the files/folders to be updated,
easy and convenient,
Improve work efficiency
